versions.subject: Create registry_set_scr_file_executed_by_rundll32.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventType: SetValue
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
registry_1:
    TargetObject|contains: '\Control Panel\Desktop\ScreenSaveActive'
    Details: '1'
registry_2:
    TargetObject|contains: '\Control Panel\Desktop\ScreenSaveTimeOut'
    Details: 900 
registry_3:
    TargetObject|contains: '\Control Panel\Desktop\SCRNSAVE.EXE'
    Details|endswith: '.scr'
condition: selection and 1 of registry_*
versions.spl: EventType="SetValue" Image="*\\rundll32.exe" (TargetObject="*\\Control Panel\\Desktop\\ScreenSaveActive*" Details="1") OR (TargetObject="*\\Control Panel\\Desktop\\ScreenSaveTimeOut*" Details=900) OR (TargetObject="*\\Control Panel\\Desktop\\SCRNSAVE.EXE*" Details="*.scr")

versions.subject: added filter
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventType: SetValue
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
registry:
    TargetObject|contains: '\Control Panel\Desktop\SCRNSAVE.EXE'
    Details|endswith: '.scr'
filter:
    Details|contains: 
    - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
    - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
    - 'C:\Windows\system32\'
    - 'C:\Windows\SysWow64\'
condition: selection and registry and not filter
versions.spl: EventType="SetValue" Image="*\\rundll32.exe" TargetObject="*\\Control Panel\\Desktop\\SCRNSAVE.EXE*" Details="*.scr" NOT (Details IN ("*C:\\Windows\\System32\\*", "*C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*", "*C:\\Windows\\system32\\*", "*C:\\Windows\\SysWow64\\*"))
